equipment_type: Split air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Daikin residential split indoor units with an S21 connector.
summary: One-unit Intesis interface that plugs into the S21 socket of a Daikin residential indoor unit and exposes it on BACnet MS/TP as 34 fixed objects. Every function has a _command object to write and a _status object to read back. It adds occupancy logic, a remote-controller lock, humidification (on units that have it) and a virtual-temperature function that uses a BMS room sensor.
notes: This MS/TP model has a larger object set than the older INBACDAI001I000 gateway (BACnet IP and MS/TP, listed separately): occupancy objects, LockRemoteControl, humidification and outdoor temperature are added.

Object names are taken from each object's Object_Name property. The summary table in the manual spells a few with different capitals (Setpoint_status, UserSetpoint_status, Setpoint_command, OccupiedCoolSetpoint and the other occupancy setpoints, UnoccupiedDeadBandAction).
Up/down and left/right air direction only offer Stop and Swing on this model.
ErrorCodeM has 156 states; the full Daikin error code table is in the manual.
Temperature units follow the °C/°F DIP switch (SW2 position 8).

source.title: IN485DAI001I000 Gateway - Daikin Residential Systems to BACnet MS/TP - User Manual

integration.summary: Plug the gateway into the indoor unit's S21 socket, set the MS/TP MAC address and baud rate on the DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit, so give each its own MAC address and device instance.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point is documented; the gateway accepts commands as soon as it talks to the unit. BV 2 LockRemoteControl can lock out the wired remote.
integration.remote_sensors: Write the BMS room temperature to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command and the setpoint to AO 0. The gateway then runs its Virtual Temperature function and recalculates the setpoint it sends to the unit; BI 14 VirtualTempActive shows it is active and AI 17 UserSetPoint_status shows the BMS setpoint.
setup: Default device instance 246000; in automatic mode it is 246000 + the MS/TP MAC address set on DIP switch SW2.
Writing Object_Identifier from BACnet switches the gateway to manual addressing until a factory reset.
Baud rate is set on SW1 P6-P8; autobaud is the default.
SW3 enables the 120-ohm terminator and bus biasing.
DIP switch changes take effect only after a reboot.
gotchas: Write the _command object and read the _status object; they are separate objects with the same instance numbers in different object types.
The Occupancy MV and its four setpoint AVs drive built-in logic; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) if the BMS handles scheduling.
Humidification objects only work on units that support humidification.
